selection_basis: User requested existing Gemini and Groq keys only. Verified IDs with both authenticated model-list endpoints on 2026-10-15. Four varied candidates for the same six-question pilot; this is not the original all-provider leaderboard top four.

models.name: GPT-OSS 120B (Groq)
models.selection_reason: Large reasoning model and the existing Project 4 provider baseline.

models.name: GPT-OSS 20B (Groq)
models.selection_reason: Smaller, cheaper model for comparison with the 120B model.

models.name: Qwen 3.8 27B (Groq)
models.selection_reason: Coding-oriented alternative, tested in instruct mode to compare cost and latency. Preview availability may change.

models.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (Google)
models.selection_reason: Confirmed live generation works. Gemini 3.8 returned HTTP 503 high demand and 2.5 Flash returned HTTP 404, so select 3.5 Flash-Lite explicitly with minimal thinking; no silent fallback.
